description: Source code for PowerHalController class managing interactions with Android Power HAL, including connection handling, fallback mechanisms, and power mode control.

classes.name: HalConnector
classes.description: Handles connection to the Power HAL, supporting multiple HAL versions and fallback.

classes.name: PowerHalController
classes.description: Manages Power HAL interactions, including initialization, fallback, and power mode controls.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the appropriate Power HAL implementation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the Power HAL loader, unloading all HALs.

methods.name: initHal
methods.description: Checks and initializes the current Power HAL handle, with fallback to default.

methods.name: processHalResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a HAL call, handling failures and resetting connection if needed.

methods.name: setBoost
methods.description: Sets a power boost with specified duration.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific power mode.

methods.name: createHintSession
methods.description: Creates a power hint session with given thread IDs and duration.

methods.name: getHintSessionPreferredRate
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred rate for hint sessions.
